Additionally, Moscow accused Tallinn of attempting a naval blockade by inspecting and seizing Russian cargo ships in the Baltic Sea, alongside oppressing Russian-speaking residents. Russia reserves the right to take political and diplomatic countermeasures. @Slavyangrad

The Saudi regime launches fresh airstrikes on the Yemeni capital of Sanaa, an Al Mayadeen correspondent reported, with no toll announced thus far. The Saudi regime has been launching daily airstrikes all over Yemen, killing and wounding numerous civilians in the process. Saudi forces carried out 72 air and missile strikes against Sanaa and several other Yemeni provinces within 24 hours, Brigadier General Yahya Saree, spokesperson for the Yemeni Armed Forces, announced on Wednesday. In a statement, Saree said the attacks targeted civilian facilities in Sanaa and the provinces of al-Jawf, Taiz, Saada, Hodeidah, Ibb, and Lahj, resulting in civilian deaths and injuries. He reported that F-15 and Typhoon warplanes took off from the Khamis Mushait and Taif bases to carry out the airstrikes, while the missile attacks were launched from Najran.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported an incident involving a vessel in the Persian Gulf near Dubai in the United Arab Emirates. "UKMTO has received a report of an incident 50 nautical miles west of Dubai, UAE. The master of a tanker has reported an explosion caused by an unknown projectile in close proximity to the tanker. The crew are safe and are accounted for and there is no damage reported to the tanker or environmental impact,” the statement said.
